Shareholder Analyst (EQ / Equiniti)

As a Shareholder Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering accurate and insightful share register analysis to support clients' investor relations and shareholder engagement strategies. Working closely with Analytics Client Managers and other internal stakeholders, you will provide high-quality analytical support, helping clients better understand their shareholder base, ownership trends, and market activity.

• Augment the database by identifying and entering data as appropriate
• Supporting the Client Managers with client liaison
• Keep up to date with important industry news / regulation changes
• Assist in training and supervising of junior team members
• Attend client training sessions and review meetings with the Client Manager
• Assist in preparing client reports
• Make recommendations and participate in the planning and improvement of the overall Analytics team
Required Knowledge and Skills
• A minimum of 6 months' experience working in the finance sector
• Experience as a Shareholder Analyst or in a similar analytical role is desirable
• Educated to degree level or equivalent
• Strong financial and capital market knowledge
• Strong computer skills
• Highly numerate
• Good communication skills
• Ability to work under pressure and to deadlines

Location: London
Role Type: Permanent

Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment firms, dedicated to helping clients achieve lasting financial success.

This position is being recruited on behalf of our client through Robert Walters' Outsourcing service line (Resource Solutions Limited).

jd_full:
AUTO HUB & TRADING LTD is seeking a skilled and analytical Business Analyst to support the company's business operations, strategic planning and commercial development within the motor vehicle sales and trading sector.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing business performance, identifying operational improvements, evaluating market trends and developing data-driven recommendations to improve efficiency, profitability and business growth. The role will involve working closely with management and operational teams to assess business requirements, monitor sales performance, improve internal processes and support informed commercial decision-making.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Analyse the company's business operations, sales performance and financial data to identify trends, performance gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify developments in the used vehicle market, customer demand, pricing trends and business opportunities.
• Evaluate vehicle purchasing, stock management and sales processes to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
• Prepare detailed business reports, performance dashboards and analytical summaries to support management decision-making and strategic planning.
• Analyse sales figures, profit margins, vehicle turnover rates and operational costs to assess business performance and recommend measures to improve profitability.
• Gather and assess business requirements from management and relevant departments, translating them into practical recommendations and improvement plans.
• Review existing business procedures and develop strategies to improve operational efficiency, resource utilisation and workflow management.
• Monitor customer purchasing patterns, market demand and sales trends to support effective vehicle stock planning and commercial strategies.
• Work with management to develop business forecasts, performance targets and operational plans based on market research and historical business data.
• Identify potential business risks and operational challenges, providing evidence-based recommendations to minimise their impact.
• Support the implementation of new business processes, reporting systems and operational improvements, monitoring their effectiveness.
• Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to collect relevant business information and ensure that operational objectives are achieved.
• Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior management, providing clear explanations of business performance and proposed improvements.

Skills and Experience Required
• Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience in business analysis, market research and performance evaluation.
• Ability to analyse complex business information and prepare detailed reports.
• Knowledge of sales performance analysis, stock management and commercial operations.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools and business analysis software.
• Strong communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to identify business improvement opportunities and develop practical solutions.
• Experience in the automotive or vehicle trading industry would be advantageous.

Reporting Structure
The Business Analyst will report directly to the company's senior management and work collaboratively with relevant operational and commercial teams to support business planning, performance monitoring and organisational development.

Pay: £45,000.00-£50,000.00 per year
Benefits: On-site parking
Work Location: In person

Marketing & Commercial Analyst

For more than 65 years, Ifor Williams Trailers has set the standard for durability, performance and innovation in trailer manufacturing. We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Marketing & Commercial Analyst to join our marketing team, supporting the growth of our online and social media presence and helping to promote sales of our trailers.

About the Role
Working alongside our content and social media team, you will support and manage our paid media activity across social and search platforms, and provide insight into how our content and advertising are performing. You may also support colleagues across the business.

Key Responsibilities
Paid media
• Plan, build, launch and optimise paid campaigns across social and search platforms.
• Monitor live campaigns and make timely adjustments.
• Use AI tools to support campaign planning and set-up.
• Test audiences, messages and formats.
• Support the promotion of our dealer network.
Performance and reporting
• Set up and track KPIs for paid and organic content.
• Analyse organic social media performance and identify opportunities.
• Produce accurate, timely reports on campaign performance.
• Turn data into clear, practical recommendations.
Collaboration
• Work with the content and social media team; support search content with paid search and audience insight.
• Bring fresh ideas backed by evidence; stay up to date with platform changes.

About You
Essential
• Strong numerical ability, confident handling and interpreting large data sets.
• Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel or equivalent), including formulas, pivot tables and charts.
• Excellent attention to detail under pressure.
• Excellent written communication; present data clearly.
• Confidence to question existing approaches, supported by evidence.
• A creative approach to problem-solving and an understanding of engaging content.
• Confident using AI tools to speed up planning, analysis and campaign set-up.
Desirable
• Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising campaigns.
• LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, YouTube or TikTok advertising.
• Google Analytics 4 or similar.
• Meta Blueprint, Google Ads or CIM certifications.

Location and Hours
Full-time, permanent, office-based at Boundary Park, Deeside. Occasional weekend and evening monitoring of live campaigns may be required.
Benefits: free on-site parking. Work Location: In person.

• Confidence working independently while knowing when to escalate.

• Power Query, Power BI, SQL or Power Automate.

jd_full:
Analyst - Pricing, Sainsbury's Data & Analytics
Salary: Competitive plus benefits. Location: London Store Support Centre and home, EC1M 6HA. Full time, permanent. Closing date: 24 November 2026.
What you'll do
As an Analyst in the Price & Promotion Analytics team, you will use data and insight to help shape how we price thousands of products and compete in a fast-moving retail market. You will analyse competitor, customer, sales and pricing data to understand our competitive position, uncover trends and opportunities and solve complex commercial problems. From developing analytical models that support smarter pricing decisions to measuring the impact of major price changes and value campaigns, your analysis will help us understand what is working and where to act next. You will work with Commercial Trading, Pricing, Value Strategy, Data Science and Engineering, turning business questions into robust analysis and clear recommendations.
Who you are
Commercially minded, curious and confident with ambiguity; strong SQL and Python; curious about AI and keen to experiment with agentic tools and workflows; collaborative, a clear communicator and data storyteller; able to balance multiple priorities.
Essential criteria
• Strong numerate background (degree or equivalent experience)
• Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python
• Experience with GitHub, Jira, Astronomer/Apache Airflow, or agentic AI tools and workflows is advantageous but not required
• Strong commercial acumen, connecting findings to customer, competitive and business outcomes
• Ability to deliver robust, high-impact analysis
• Skilled at simplifying complexity and structuring ambiguous problems
• Strong communication and storytelling ability
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities at speed
• Growth mindset and proactive approach to development
Benefits include colleague discount, pension and life cover, performance bonus up to 10%, holiday purchase, season ticket loans and flexible working where possible.

jd_full:
A leading organisation is seeking a Technical Business Analyst for its trading platforms team in London (on-site). Requires 8+ years in commodity trading, price risk management or capital markets, and deep expertise in global futures exchanges and exchange-traded derivatives.

• Act as subject matter expert for trading systems initiatives; troubleshoot with development, support and business users.
• Analyse and map RFQ, order and trade lifecycles.
• Facilitate stakeholder workshops and translate business needs into technical solutions.
• Hands-on experience delivering scalable algorithmic trading technology; MiFID II, EMIR and FCA knowledge.
• Market data providers, liquidity aggregation, EMS/OMS vendors.
• Scripting, Python, PowerShell, C#, SQL; FIX engineering, messaging systems, network protocol debugging.
• AI-assisted requirements analysis valued.

Recruited by Computer Futures (SThree Partnership LLP) acting as an Employment Business.
